name: DRLVaultV3 permissionless swap uses manipulated spot quote
summary: The fixed-clone vault exposed swapToWETH to any caller and derived amountOutMinimum from a same-transaction quote of the pool being traded. The attacker moved that pool first, forced the vault to exchange 100,000 USDC for 0.000120518513556060 WETH, then reversed the manipulation.
notes: Clone basis: the vault clone pins its master and held the USDC inventory sold through the unguarded swap path.

Gross victim value lost before recoveries: receipt Transfer log 12 spends 100,000 USDC (6 decimals); log 11 returns 0.000120518513556060 WETH (18 decimals). The component records raw USDC spent but values only its uncompensated portion: 100000 - 0.000120518513556060 × 3600.626 = 99999.56605790661 USD. USDC uses par and WETH uses the pre-exploit Chainlink ETH/USD answer. Contemporaneous consideration is deducted; attacker financing, fees, builder payments and later recoveries are not. Full USDC/WETH outgoing-log history from clone creation through the exploit contains only this USDC payment.
